name: LEITNER Natur-Bobbahn Berlin
standaloneRelevance: The Kienbergpark is free to enter but the bob run has its own ticket counter and admission price; separate visitor decision confirmed by operator.
editorial: Eight descriptions rewritten; five displayed offers; official age, accompaniment and height rules; 167 dated overrides from current winter closure through 30 April 2027.

calendar.nuance: Operator states daily 10:30–16:00 after seasonal start; ticket office closes 15:00. Later dates require recheck.

pricing: Adult €6.50 single or €16 three rides; reduced €5/€12 for age 6–17 and disability rating 50+; age 3–5 up to three free rides daily. Sold at the attraction counter.
